rubric.role_summary: Product designer for a sleep and health mobile app, responsible for end-to-end UX and UI design, validation, and iteration. The role includes collaboration across product and engineering and coaching junior designers.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Product designer for a sleep and health mobile app, responsible for end-to-end UX and UI design, validation, and iteration. The role includes collaboration across product and engineering and coaching junior designers.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 4+ years of UX and UI experience.
- Bachelor’s degree in a related design field or equivalent experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience building consumer-facing mobile apps at small or mid-size tech startups, supported by data and reviews.
- Experience designing Android mobile apps.
- Experience shipping designs to public users and having data showing their success or failure.
- Ability to consider technical implications of design decisions and balance new-user value against technical effort.
- Experience coaching junior designers and collaborating closely with product managers and engineers.
- Ability to manage the design process end to end.
- Ability to write clear agendas and decks and present design evolutions to C-suite leadership.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): New York metropolitan area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.
